concerns.text: FR-010 mandates 100 permutations; tasks implement 1,000 and document the override only in docs/DEVIATIONS.md (T047b). The spec was never amended — the plan itself says 'a spec amendment is required.' Tasks silently resolve a spec/plan conflict in the plan's favor, leaving FR-010 as written unsatisfied. Amend the spec or route the conflict through the sanctioned amendment path before tasks bake in the override.

Spec assumes sampling to N=50 and measures SC-002 runtime at N=50; tasks hard-gate N≥85 (T046, T078) per the plan, which itself flags 'a spec amendment is required.' No amendment exists, so SC-002's measurable condition (6h at N=50) is unachievable under the tasks as written.

SC-005 requires test-retest reliability (ICC ≥ 0.7) on subjects with repeated scans. No task identifies repeated-scan subjects or computes test-retest ICC; T026–T028/T074 compute ICC across window sizes (FR-011 stability), which is a different criterion. SC-005's acceptance criterion is dropped.

T038b specifies final_results.csv columns 'subject_id, metric, genre, r, p_raw, p_adj, p_adj_bh' while claiming conformance to correlations.schema.yaml, whose required fields are metric_name, network_type, genre, spearman_r, p_raw, p_adjusted, is_significant, power_achieved, permutation_count. The column list cannot conform to the contract as written; the spurious per-subject column and duplicate p_adj/p_adj_bh invite a non-conforming artifact.

T077 requires a 5-subject end-to-end run to 'produce real result rows', but T046/T038c mandate exit code 1 with ERR_UNDERPOWERED when N < 85. The thin run necessarily trips the hard gate, so T077's verification is unsatisfiable as written. The task must explicitly scope the gate (e.g., pilot-mode bypass documented in DEVIATIONS.md) or the verification must accept the gate exit.

T072's example 'Sampled N=50 from N=100 using seed 42' describes exactly the sampling the plan forbids ('NO SAMPLING TO N=50... halts if N < 85'). As written it invites reintroducing the underpowered sampling the hard gate exists to prevent; the task should state that any sampling below N=85 triggers ERR_UNDERPOWERED.

SC-001 requires a measured ≥80% successful-preprocessing rate against total available subjects. T078 reports exclusion counts but no task computes or checks the SC-001 ratio with a pass/fail outcome — the acceptance criterion is silently dropped.

Data model declares the results artifact as data/derived/correlations.csv; tasks write only data/derived/final_results.csv. Same artifact, two names — an implementer following the data model produces a file no task verifies. Align the filename.

Plan marks Principle II (Verified Accuracy) as BLOCKING: 'cannot proceed until a verified source [for STOMP-R/musical preference] is identified or the spec is amended.' No task discharges this gate (e.g., verifying a dataset actually containing the behavioral variable), yet T077–T081 assume real results. At minimum, T077's verification should explicitly treat ERR_DATA_MISSING as a legitimate, documented outcome rather than a task failure.
